text.p: AMC Entertainment Inc said Tuesday it had 558 screens in 25 locations under construction at the end of its fiscal year.
AMC, an entertainment company that is principally involved in motion picture exhibition, added 314 screens in 17 locations in fiscal 1997, ended April 3.
AMC currently has 1,973 screens in 227 theaters in 23 states, the District of Columbia, Portugal and Japan.
Earlier, AMC reported operating earnings for fiscal 1997 of $0.74 a share, down from $1.21 a year ago before an extraordinary charge.

Earnings for fiscal 1997 were hurt due to movies from key suppliers during the first nine months that failed to deliver box office results delivered in the prior year, AMC said. In addition, AMC said it experienced start-up costs associated with opening 314 new screens, including 268 megaplex screens.
General and administrative expenses increased, as anticipated, partially due to its strategic growth initiative in the United States and internationally.
